extension.description: Manage Git branches, inspect current-line history, and generate AI-powered commit messages in VS Code.
settings.provider: AI provider for commit messages and split commits.
settings.baseUrl: Base URL of the selected provider.
settings.composer.model: Model used to split changes into commit drafts and refine them.
settings.model: Model used to generate commit messages.
settings.prompt: Custom instructions for generating commit messages.
settings.blame.enabled: Show commit information for the current line in the editor.
settings.blame.avatars: Show author avatars from GitHub or Gravatar in branch history and blame hovers. Missing Gravatars use RoboHash artwork.
branches.welcome: Open a Git repository to manage its branches.
branches.currentColor: Color of the checked-out branch indicator in Smart Git Pilot.
branches.currentIcon: Branch with filled nodes for the current checkout.
